title: Alternative comforter – YES but definitely not goose down; very soft
text:
Alternative comforter – YES but definitely not goose down; very soft. I was going to give this at least 4.5 stars because it is so soft, fluffy, comfortable, and vibrant. However, the Amazon site is very misleading as it says it is goose down, then in the next sentence it says it is alternative. This comforter has box squares stitched to keep the "cotton" in place. It feels like airy cotton inside the comforter. I personally love the way it looks, although I expected a better match with my purple bedroom. This "wine" color is really a fuchsia or hot pink than wine and the reverse side is a light pink. I like using this without a duvet. However, if I wanted to cover it, there are loops in all four corners and in the center to hold it in place inside a duvet.

It is lightweight and warm enough. I have not washed this yet and will not do that until after I used it for several months. I am unsure how this will hold up in the wash. I suspect the cotton in the squares will bunch up and have to be smooth out or may remain lumpy. It should be washed in cold water and hung to dry. It is made in India of 100% microfibre.

Overall, I really love the comfort of this comforter and one of my three cats would not get off the bed once I put this down--so it is cat approved as well.

product_metadata.title: Q Quard Microfiber King Size Comforter 200 GSM Premium Brushed Reversible Cover Alternative Duvet Insert with 6 Built in Corner - Lightweight - All Season - Box Stitched - White
features: EXTREME SOFT & FLUFFY: This down alternative comforter from Q QUARD is made from double-brushed microfiber to provide you with an extremely soft and breathable feel. The comforter is lightweight, wrinkle-free, and noise-free, providing you with a comfortable and cozy sleeping experience.

REVERSIBLE & BOX-STICHED DESIGN: The Q QUARD comforter is reversible, you can quickly alter the appearance of your bedroom by flipping it over or tucking it inside a duvet cover. The filling is kept away from moving or spilling out thanks to the traditional box stitching technique. You can effortlessly attach a duvet cover to the comforter with loops and corner tabs to keep it in place. The comforter can be used as a stand-alone comforter or as a duvet insert.

SUITABLE FOR EVERY SEASON: With 200 GSM plush microfiber filler offers a fluffy look and good puff. The comforter is suitable for year-round use, it cools you down on hot summer evenings and keeps you cozy and warm on cold winter nights thanks to the box pattern that keeps the microfiber filling uniformly distributed and breathable.

AVAILABLE IN DIFFERENT SIZES & COLOR SCHEME: Three sizes are available now, get the right size for your bed, Twin of 65 x 89, Queen of 88 x 88, King of 91 x 109. This comforter offers a wide variety of neutral color options so you can style it however you like.

EASY CLEANING ANYTIME: The comforter can be machine washed, and are easy to maintain. The product washes and dries wonderfully, more durable than cotton. Simply use cold water, and choose a regular cycle with no bleach or fabric softener and no fabric dryer protectors. Dry on low heat. 40 Degrees Celsius Machine Wash (DO NOT BLEACH, DO NOT IRON, and DO NOT WRING).
